body:
Track robofab follow-up to `robofab-toppconv` (its next steps). Recomputes the 9 no-speed-limit rows of `robofab-scurve` with the time-optimal solver at n = 400..25600 and the trapezoid at 40 and 160 extra ramp samples.

Result (stylised): time-optimal carry 9.4% to 23.0% faster than the tuned trapezoid in all rows; solver converged to 0.004% by n = 6400; denser ramp sampling slows the trapezoid 0.05–0.5%.

Checks: 50 tests pass, `python site/build.py` prints ok, README bullet and `site/projects.json` entry added.
